Method of Attack: Harvest data, record audio and video, access sensitive communication information
Recording with microphone, front & rear cameras
Collecting SMS and multimedia message contents, call logs
Sending SMS messages, blocking incoming SMS
Overriding system settings such as GPS & Network
Modifying files on the phone's filesystem
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps mimicking YouTube, distributed outside Google Play, socially engineered installation
Indicators of Compromise: Hardcoded C2 server addresses in app configuration file associated with Transparent Tribe activities
APK uploads to VirusTotal in April, July, and August 2023
